Using \(101A+10B+C=B^C\), the left side is between \(101\) and \(1008\), so we only test digit pairs with \(101\le B^C\le 1008\).

For \(B=2\):
- \(2^7=128\): \(A=\frac{128-20-7}{101}=1\), giving \(ABC=127\).
- Other powers in range give non-integer \(A\).

Testing \(B=3,\dots,9\) with powers in range gives no integer digit \(A\). Also \(B=0,1\) fail.

Thus the number is \(\boxed{127}\).
